Under Nigel's leadership, Evercore had become the market leader in transaction volume and is involved in approximately 30-40% of all secondaries market activity . Our conversation covers Nigel's observations on the growing secondaries market, including its history, rationale for LPs and GPs, incentives, critiques, other liquidity options.

 Nigel Dawn - Secondaries in Private Markets (EP.378) 
 
 Nigel Dawn - Secondaries in Private Markets (EP.378) Apr 8, 2024

 Nigel Dawn is the global head of Private
Capital Advisory at Evercore, where he leads the secondaries
business he started a decade ago. Under Nigel's leadership,
Evercore had become the market leader in transaction volume and is
involved in approximately 30-40% of all secondaries market activity
.

 Our conversation covers Nigel's observations
on the growing secondaries market, including its history, rationale
for LPs and GPs, incentives, critiques, other liquidity options,
and advice for both sellers and buyers of GP interests.

 About the Podcast 
 
 
 Allocator and asset management expert, Ted Seides, conducts in-depth interviews with leaders in the institutional investing industry. Guests include Chief Investment Officers from leading allocators, asset managers, strategists, thought leaders, and many more. Our mission is to learn, share, and help implement the process of premier investors. Learn more and join our community at capitalallocators.com.
